summary: Iteration-4: verified both user-reported bug fixes plus all regressions. BUG FIX #1 (Admin About & Contact tab) — clicking [data-testid=admin-settings-tab] no longer throws ReferenceError; heading 'About & Contact' renders, founder photo preview visible, form values match spec (Full name='Agastya', Role='Founder & Creative Technologist — Agastya Studios', non-empty Bio, contact_email='devexpertaug@gmail.com', WhatsApp='+917906411716'), editing bio → clicking [data-testid=admin-save-settings] returned PUT /api/settings 200 with success toast 'Saved. Refresh the homepage to see it.'; original bio was restored. BUG FIX #2 (Cursor lag) — global `cursor: none` rule fully removed (grep of /app/frontend/src/ returns 0 matches for both 'cursor: none' and 'cursor-dot'); body computed cursor='auto', exactly ONE .cursor-ring element in DOM, ZERO .cursor-dot elements, ring transform updates on mousemove (from translate3d(101px,92px) → translate3d(627px,393px)), hovering a button toggles .cursor-ring-lg and computed width becomes 55.875px (≈56px spec), pointer-events on ring is 'none' so it doesn't block clicks. REGRESSIONS ALL PASS: (a) Projects tab shows 6 seeded cards + Add project button; Add opens modal titled 'New project' with 'Full story (project page) — optional' textarea; Cancel closes. (b) Services tab shows 10 admin-service-edit-{slug} buttons; opening admin-service-edit-voice reveals modal with title, blurb, cover image (file + URL), Features (one per line), Workflow, Web-dev layer note; Cancel closes. (c) Home has hero (Forests hold / the quiet intelligence.), services, pricing (Seed/Grove/Forest, no ₹), footer with 'Garhwal', 'Chat to Rishi' pill visible bottom-right. (d) /work/{uuid} loads with 'story' section. (e) /services/voice loads. (f) /login with wrong password stays on /login; correct creds redirect to /admin. (g) 0 console errors on /, /work/{id}, /services/voice, /login, /admin (single pre-login 401 on /api/auth/me is expected and not counted).
critical_code_review_comments: Cursor.jsx correctly hides via early-return on window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches, and index.css also has @media (pointer: coarse) { .cursor-ring { display: none; } } as a CSS-level backup — double-guarded, good defense-in-depth.
RAF-lerp loop with 0.22 factor + refs (no setState in tick) is optimal — verified transform updates on mousemove with zero React re-renders and 0 console errors.
AdminPage SettingsTab now has the required useState(null) for settings + loading + saving; PUT /api/settings returned 200 in-flow. Payload structure matches server.py SettingsIn model.
Cursor pointer-events:none means the ring cannot intercept clicks — verified via computed style. Good.

Mobile pointer:coarse guard could not be fully exercised via Playwright viewport resize alone (matchMedia still reports 'fine' without has_touch context). The code+CSS guards are however unambiguously correct; recommend a manual smoke on a real touch device or a Playwright context with has_touch=true if strict coverage is desired.

rca of the issue: Bug#1 (Admin About & Contact crash) RCA: The SettingsTab function was missing `const [settings, setSettings] = useState(null);` — a refactor in an earlier iteration removed it, so JSX referencing `settings.founder_name` etc. threw ReferenceError as soon as the tab was activated. Fix (already applied by main agent) restores this line at the top of SettingsTab. Verified: no runtime error, PUT returns 200. Bug#2 (Cursor lag) RCA: Prior implementation set `cursor: none !important` globally, hiding the native OS pointer and forcing users to rely on a JS-driven .cursor-dot that lagged behind mouse position (unthrottled mousemove + mix-blend-mode compositing hit). Fix: keep native OS cursor visible (zero lag), delete .cursor-dot entirely, keep only the aesthetic .cursor-ring which lerps via RAF (0.22) and cannot block clicks (pointer-events:none). Verified: body cursor='auto', 1 ring, 0 dots, ring pointer-events='none'.
